replies.author: fluffymeowmeowkitty
replies.body:
I threw in bunch of conditions, un orthodox conditions.  I gave 10 2x etfs.    
It checks to see which one are performing the worst that day.  It buys 2.5% equity limit buys.  Two symbols per day.  And cap of 20% per stock.   50% take profit.  Trailing stops that activate after few weeks.  Pause between buys.  Things like that. There a lot of these and somehow it drew this chart.  And I’m in disbelief.    Im working on then live tester.

comments.author: silphotographer
comments.body:
Not sure how you can do basic due diligence testing. If it's LLM based code wise, then it would choose to operate differently depending on the input. I suppose one could do randomized Monty Carlos style test but what I fear is that it'd be literally crafting overfitting data as it intakes the data dynamically.

I think it'd make more send to do forward testing though it's hard to guess without knowing how the algo works.
